name: Button
description: Pill actions with neutral, semantic, and AI variants.

name: Badge
description: Compact status pills in soft intent colors.

name: Input
description: A pill text field with a quiet fill and a primary focus ring.

name: Textarea
description: Multi-line input matching the field style.

name: Label
description: An accessible, selectable form label.

name: Checkbox
description: A compact checkbox whose check draws itself in, with Shift-click range selection in a group.

name: Radio Group
description: A single choice with keyboard navigation, as rows or cards with a gliding selection ring.

name: Switch
description: A pill switch for an immediate on or off choice.

name: Slider
description: A track with a contrasting range, springy thumbs, value bubbles, and an optional elastic pull past the ends.

name: Select
description: A clean dropdown with highlighted items.

name: Card
description: A flexible content surface with soft elevation.

name: Alert
description: Quiet callouts in four intents.

name: Separator
description: A subtle semantic divider for sections.

name: Avatar
description: A rounded image with a graceful fallback and a status badge that morphs between presences.

name: Dialog
description: A clean modal over a blurred scrim that steps back when a confirmation opens on top.

name: Popover
description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger.

name: Tooltip
description: A small hint on hover or focus. In a group, one bubble slides between triggers.

name: Tabs
description: A segmented pill switcher whose raised active tab slides between triggers.

name: Accordion
description: Collapsible sections with a smooth height transition.

name: Progress
description: A neutral track with a contrasting progress indicator.

name: Skeleton
description: A shimmering placeholder that swaps into content top to bottom.

name: Spinner
description: A loading indicator in four styles that finishes with a check.

name: Circular Gauge
description: A ring or tick dial that sweeps to its value and holds a peak.

name: Alert Dialog
description: A clean modal that interrupts for a confirmation.

name: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from any edge.

name: Drawer
description: A bottom sheet you drag or flick away, with nested drawers that push the one behind back.

name: Hover Card
description: A card revealed on hover or focus. In a group, one card travels between names.

name: Confirm Popover
description: Asks before a destructive action, from a popover that grows out of its button.

name: Selection Toolbar
description: A toolbar that grows out of whatever text you select.

name: Link Preview
description: A preview card that trails your cursor over a link and leans as it moves. Keyboard focus shows it too, so it suits citations.

name: Shortcut Sheet
description: Press ? to see every shortcut, then press one to watch it light up.

name: Dropdown Menu
description: A crisp menu of actions, with submenus and checks.

name: Context Menu
description: A right-click menu, clean and quiet.

name: Menubar
description: A desktop-style bar of dropdown menus.

name: Navigation Menu
description: Site navigation with floating dropdown panels.

name: Command
description: A searchable command palette.

name: Combobox
description: A searchable select in a clean popover.

name: Toggle
description: A two-state button with a soft pressed look.

name: Toggle Group
description: A segmented set of toggles in a pill rail.

name: Input OTP
description: One-time-code slots with a gliding focus ring, a blinking caret, and a shake on a wrong code.

name: Input Group
description: An input fused with leading or trailing add-ons.

name: Field
description: Label, control, hint, and error, grouped.

name: Native Select
description: A styled native select, no JS required.

name: Collapsible
description: A single open-and-close disclosure.

name: Breadcrumb
description: A path trail back to the top.

name: Pagination
description: Page-by-page navigation controls.

name: Scroll Area
description: A scroll container with a slim, quiet bar.

name: Aspect Ratio
description: Hold content to a fixed ratio.

name: Table
description: A clean, rounded data table.

name: Empty
description: A friendly empty state.

name: Item
description: A composable list row.

name: Kbd
description: A keyboard-key badge.

name: Button Group
description: Buttons joined into one segmented control.

name: Toast
description: Notifications that stack, fan out on hover, and drain their edge as a timer, with undo and promise toasts.

name: Meter
description: A semantic gauge whose fill shifts across thresholds, or a segmented breakdown you can point at.

name: Banner
description: An announcement bar that folds away on dismiss while the page slides up to fill the gap.

name: Checklist
description: A setup checklist that counts up as you go and celebrates the finish.

name: Save Status
description: A dot for unsaved changes splits into three while saving, then gathers into a check.

name: Live Indicator
description: Breathes while live and blinks hollow while reconnecting.

name: Calendar
description: A month grid with a contrasting selected day.

name: Range Calendar
description: Pick a span of dates with a clean month grid.

name: Date Picker
description: A pill date field with a popover calendar.

name: Rating
description: Fillable symbols that preview on hover and pop when chosen.

name: Tags Input
description: A field whose typed words become chips right where they are.

name: Carousel
description: A swipeable slider with pill controls, and a focus mode where neighbors shrink and fade.

name: Resizable
description: Draggable panes split by a quiet handle.

name: Data Table
description: TanStack-powered tables whose rows glide when sorted, with a bulk action bar that rises for selections.

name: Timeline
description: A vertical history whose line grows down to meet each new event.

name: Swipe Deck
description: Fling a card away and the rest of the deck steps forward.

name: Expanding Card
description: Grows from its slot into a detail view and folds back when you are done.

name: Sortable
description: Pick up a row or tile and the rest slide out of its way.

name: Kanban
description: Lift a card between columns and the others make room for it.

name: Drag Select
description: Draw a box across items to select them, like a desktop.

name: Compare Slider
description: Drag the divider to compare a before and after.

name: Code Block
description: Switch files with a sliding underline and copy with one click.

name: Image Hotspots
description: A leader line travels between labeled points on an image without covering it.

name: Avatar Stack
description: A row of faces that fans open when you reach for it, with a name above each.

name: Sidebar
description: A collapsible app sidebar that folds to a slim rail.

name: Stepper
description: A multi-step progress trail with quiet nodes.

name: Tree
description: A nested, keyboard-navigable file-style tree.

name: Dock
description: A dock that magnifies icons under the cursor.

name: Link
description: An underline that enters from the side your cursor came in and leaves the way it left.

name: Page Dots
description: A pill that inches between pages like a worm and counts down to the next.

name: Back to Top
description: Fills its ring as you read, then lifts the page back up.

name: Reading Progress
description: A bar that fills as you read while the time left counts down.

name: Scroll Spine
description: Maps a document as a spine of bands sized to each section, filling as you read.

name: Aurora
description: A slow, drifting pastel-aura backdrop.

name: Chat Input
description: A message composer with optional attachment and voice actions.

name: Chat Bubble
description: User and assistant message bubbles, flat and quiet.

name: Streaming Text
description: Token-by-token text that types itself in, caret and all.

name: Reasoning
description: A collapsible chain of thought: shimmers while thinking, folds away when done.

name: Tool Call
description: Live status for a tool the assistant is using, with an expandable result.

name: Sources
description: Numbered citation chips that ground an answer.

name: Message Actions
description: Copy, regenerate, and feedback beneath a reply.

name: Plan
description: The agent's step list: shimmer while working, checks as it lands.

name: Nudge
description: A proactive suggestion from the assistant, easy to act on or dismiss.

name: Aura Tile
description: Seeded pastel cover art for anything the AI generates.

name: Voice Orb
description: A voice orb in two styles: a folded cloud, or glassy mist that listens to a live mic, swirls while thinking, and breathes while speaking.

name: Waveform
description: Animated voice bars for listening and speaking states.

name: Prompt Suggestions
description: Starter prompt chips that invite the first message.

name: Thinking
description: Shimmer and typing-dot indicators for a working assistant.

name: Motion
description: Easing, springs, transitions, and scroll reveals that share the theme's motion tokens.

name: Presence
description: An expressive companion that shows when an assistant is listening, thinking, speaking, or done.

name: Conversation
description: A message thread that follows new replies only while you are at the bottom.

name: Feedback Prompt
description: Asks whether a response helped, and opens into a field right where the question was.

name: Call Controls
description: Accept turns into hang up as the call controls unfold out of it.

name: Audio Player
description: Inks in a voice note waveform with chapter markers and a ghost playhead.

name: Greeting
description: Greets by time of day as a sun or moon rises into place along an arc.

name: Text Reveal
description: Reveals a line or an answer word by word or character by character, on mount or on scroll.

name: Text Rotate
description: Cycles a word in place while the line around it eases to fit.

name: Number Ticker
description: A formatted number whose digits roll into place when the value changes.

name: Marquee
description: An endless, pausable scroller for logos, testimonials, and prompt chips.

name: Text Scramble
description: A block cursor reads a word in, one letter at a time.

name: Typewriter
description: Types, pauses, and rewrites the last word with a human rhythm.

name: Wave Text
description: Letters rise in a wave that follows your cursor.

name: Spoiler
description: Hides text under shimmering grain that blows away from your click.

name: Highlight
description: Swipes a highlighter across a line when it comes into view.

name: Code Morph
description: Glides every surviving token to its new spot as code changes.

name: Icon Morph
description: Icons reshape between states instead of swapping.

name: Confetti
description: A burst of confetti for moments worth celebrating, as a button or a confetti() call.

name: Tilt Card
description: Leans toward your cursor with a glare that follows the light.

name: Spotlight Card
description: Cards catch the glow of a cursor lamp.

name: Flip Card
description: Turns over in 3D to show what is on the back.

name: Lens
description: A lens follows your cursor and reveals what is hidden underneath.

name: Sticky Stack
description: Cards pile up and sink back as you scroll.

name: Carousel 3D
description: Spin a ring of cards and flick it to land on the one you want.

name: Logo Orbit
description: Logos orbit a heading on tilted rings and brake when you point.

name: Dot Grid
description: Dots swell and part around your cursor, and a click sends a shockwave.

name: Tab Bar
description: Bottom navigation for mobile apps and PWAs, with a sliding indicator and unread badges.

name: Install Prompt
description: A card that offers to install your PWA, with Add to Home Screen steps on iOS.

name: Network Status
description: An online and offline indicator that reassures people their changes will sync.

name: Dynamic Island
description: A pill that morphs between live activities with a springy bounce.

name: Pull to Refresh
description: Pull a feed down and new items slide in at the top.

name: Story Progress
description: Tap through stories, and hold to pause.

name: Segmented Control
description: A pill track of mutually exclusive options with a thumb that springs to the selection.

name: Number Input
description: Rolls each digit the way the count moves, and speeds up the longer you hold.

name: Password Input
description: Reveals with a wave of dots turning into letters, warns about caps lock, and meters strength.

name: Floating Label
description: A field whose label lifts out of the way letter by letter and never covers your text.

name: Email Input
description: Catches a mistyped domain and fixes it by moving only the letters that were wrong.

name: Expanding Search
description: Opens from a circle into a search field, and closes faster than it opens.

name: Inline Edit
description: Edits text in place without moving a pixel.

name: File Dropzone
description: Its dashed edge marches when a file enters the window and seals solid when it is overhead.

name: Color Swatches
description: A ring glides to the color you pick while the choice floods the preview.

name: Color Picker
description: Drag a color out of the square, then fine-tune hue and opacity.

name: Wheel Picker
description: Spins through values on a curved drum, like the iOS time picker.

name: Shortcut Recorder
description: Press keys to set a shortcut; keycaps appear as you hold them and conflicts are flagged.

name: Hold Button
description: A pill you press and hold to confirm, with a fill that sweeps across and an optional bin lid that slams shut.

name: Copy Button
description: Copies a value as its two pages merge and a check draws in, or flips its letters into a confirmation.

name: Upload Button
description: Shrinks into a progress ring while a file uploads, then checks off.

name: Download Button
description: The arrow drops into the tray while the pill fills with progress.

name: Async Button
description: Shrinks into a spinner while it works, then answers with a check or a shake.

name: Send Button
description: The plane lifts off along a curve and a check lands in its place. Pairs with chat composers.

name: Slide to Confirm
description: Drag the knob across to confirm a consequential action.

name: Share Button
description: Opens in place into share targets, and the link turns into a check once copied.

name: Like Button
description: Pops, bursts, and rolls its count when liked.

name: Star Button
description: Spins once, throws off sparks, and rolls the count.

name: Bookmark Button
description: Fills from the bottom up and lands with a small squash.

name: Follow Button
description: Turns its plus into a check, and asks before unfollowing.

name: Reactions
description: Add a reaction and watch it fly into its pill as the count rolls.

name: Notification Bell
description: Rings when something arrives while its badge rolls up.

name: Theme Toggle
description: A sun that folds its rays away into a crescent moon.

name: Sparkline
description: Draws itself in, then scrubs to the nearest point under your cursor.

name: Bar Chart
description: Grows its bars from the baseline and springs between series.

name: Donut Chart
description: Draws itself in, then lifts whichever slice you point at.

name: Heatmap
description: A year of activity at a glance, sweeping in week by week.

name: Stat
description: A figure that counts up, and rolls back through its history as you scrub the trend.

name: Leaderboard
description: Rows glide past each other to their new ranks.

name: Uptime Bar
description: Point at any day and the caption tells you what happened.

name: Relative Time
description: A timestamp that says how long ago in words and keeps itself current.
